blocks_9: History is hard-clipped under every header, slicing a text line in half on most chat screens
Surfaces are too flat: card, rail and list separation is 1.06-1.33:1, and dark cards are recessed rather than raised

Rough edges in secondary screens: settings bottom artefact, crowded meeting system lines, composer scrollbar, toolbar collisions
Calendar and Calls detail pages are sparse, with header actions floating mid-bar

top_issues.issue: Scrolled message history is hard-clipped under the header, slicing a text line or card in half
top_issues.evidence: 'on focus, never in a loop.' glyphs cut at y≈52 directly under the header divider #dfdfe3 (light) / #303137 (dark); in channel a reaction pill fragment shows at y 46-52
top_issues.fix: Inset the scroll viewport 8 px below the header and add a 12 px fade from the page colour (#ffffff/#1a1b1f) to transparent at the top edge, or snap the restored scroll so a message starts at the top

top_issues.issue: Surface ladder too flat: cards, rail, list and skeletons barely separate from their backgrounds
top_issues.evidence: card fill #f3f4f6 on #ffffff 1.10:1, card border #dfdfe3 1.33:1; dark card #141518 on #1a1b1f 1.06:1; rail #e7e8eb vs list #f3f4f6 1.11:1 (dark #0c0d0f vs #141518 1.06:1); skeleton #e2e3e8 on #f3f4f6 1.16:1
top_issues.fix: Light: card border #c9cbd1 (≈1.6:1), rail #e2e4e8 plus a 1 px #d5d7dc divider. Dark: card fill #212227 (raised, not recessed) with border #3a3b42, a rail/list divider #26272c, skeleton #2c2d33 on #141518

top_issues.issue: Identity colours collide: avatars and team tiles repeat, and one tile matches the accent
top_issues.evidence: AL and AT both #4560c4; O and HL both #1f7a5c; Engineering and Contoso tiles both #c2416f; Product tile #b4581c vs accent #b4530a (ΔE tiny)
top_issues.fix: Hash into 10-12 distinct hues and drop orange from the identity palette (keep it for the accent), e.g. add #7a4fc2, #a1365a, #2f7f7a, #6b6f1f, #8c4a2f, all ≥4.5:1 with white

top_issues.evidence: Settings segmented: solid #b4530a fill with white text; image-preview segmented: #e2e3e8 fill on white (1.28:1); list rows: #e2e3e8 plus a 3 px accent bar
top_issues.fix: One rule: segmented controls get a raised #ffffff thumb on a #e7e8eb track (dark #34353c on #1f2025) with a 600 weight label; reserve solid accent fill for primary buttons only

top_issues.issue: The focused composer's 2 px accent ring is the loudest element and competes with mentions and unread states
top_issues.evidence: 2 px #b4530a ring (light) / #e88c3e (dark) across 856 px wide, on screen by default in group-chat and channel
top_issues.fix: Use a 1 px accent border plus a 3 px 25%-alpha accent halo, or a 1.5 px #7c7f87→#4a4d55 border darkening on focus; keep full accent for keyboard focus only

top_issues.issue: Bottom of the scrolling settings body shows a half-visible control band that looks like a glitch
top_issues.evidence: grey band y 692-697 at the modal bottom, cut by the 24 px modal padding
top_issues.fix: Add a 16 px bottom fade (#ffffff/#26272c to transparent) above the modal padding, or end the scroll area on a section boundary

top_issues.issue: Meeting system lines break the vertical rhythm
top_issues.evidence: 'Meeting ended: 58 min · 14:44' baseline 8 px under the previous message text (566→597) vs 24-28 px between messages
top_issues.fix: Give system lines 16 px top and bottom margin, matching the date separators

top_issues.issue: Detail pages use a fixed 720 px column with header actions floating mid-bar
top_issues.evidence: Copy link/Join end at x=1114 in a 916 px pane; 166 px dead space on the right; calendar title cap at y=8 vs 11 for chat headers
top_issues.fix: Pin header actions to the pane edge (24 px inset) or centre the 720 column; give two-line headers 10 px top padding

top_issues.issue: At 760 px the 232 px list truncates most names
top_issues.evidence: 'Katherine Jo...', 'Grace Ho...', 'Margaret Hamil...' while time stamps hold 50 px
top_issues.fix: Below 820 px drop the rail labels (rail 48 px) or let the list collapse to avatars plus names, and move times under names

top_issues.issue: Away and Be right back share one colour; the amber is near the orange accent family
top_issues.fix: Keep away amber #8f6a00 but render BRB as an amber clock with no fill, or shift the accent away from orange (e.g. #3b5bdb/#8fa8ff) so status colours stand alone

top_issues.issue: Disabled filter placeholder and skeletons nearly vanish while loading
top_issues.fix: Keep the placeholder at #62656d/#9c9ea8 (5.3:1/6.4:1) and show 'Loading...' text in the list

top_issues.issue: Empty states leave whole columns blank or offer no action
top_issues.evidence: first-sync-empty: list column 64-363 px empty with no message; teams and chat no-selection have hint text only
top_issues.fix: Add a 13 pt grey 'No chats yet' line in the list and a secondary 'New chat' button in no-selection states

top_issues.issue: Composer helper text is always on and duplicates the placeholder
top_issues.evidence: 'Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · Markdown formatting works' in 12 pt #62656d under every composer, plus '· @ to mention' in the placeholder
top_issues.fix: Show the hint only while the composer is focused and not empty, or move it to the shortcuts overlay

top_issues.issue: Composer scrollbar is jammed beside the attach button
top_issues.evidence: 40 px scrollbar thumb at x≈1167, y 712-751, 10 px from the paperclip
top_issues.fix: Run the scrollbar the full text-area height at the text area's right edge, with 8 px clearance from the action icons

top_issues.issue: Hover toolbar collides with post card borders
top_issues.evidence: toolbar x 1096-1252 overlaps the card's right border at x 1252-1255 and sits 3 px under the card top
top_issues.fix: Anchor the toolbar inside the card: 8 px from its right edge, centred on the -16 px top border like chat rows
